description: World Calendars and Date Conversion API. Convert dates between the world's calendars and get every month, weekday and era name in 657 locales. Routes: /days (from, to, limit, offset); /convert (date, locale); /paydays (country, from, to, kind, limit, offset); /systems (locale); /era-names (calendar, locale, width, limit, offset); /festivals (year, tradition, festival_id, country, limit, offset); /month-names (calendar, locale, context, width, limit, offset); /solar-terms (year, limit, offset); /systems/{id} (locale); /to-gregorian (calendar, date); /weekday-names (locale, context, width, limit, offset); /paydays/{iso2} (from, to, kind, limit, offset); /countries/{iso2}. Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /days, /convert, /paydays, /systems, /era-names, /festivals, /month-names, /solar-terms, /systems/{id}, /to-gregorian, /weekday-names, /paydays/{iso2}, /countries/{iso2}. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: calendars
